summary.text: Chris Tomlinson is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 5 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The district elects three delegates, and the general election field also includes Republicans April Rose and Steve Whisler and Democrats Dayana Bergman, Alison Rudolph and Courtney Welch.
He works as a contracts manager at the Maryland Transit Administration and serves on the Government, Labor, and Elections Committee.

paragraphs.text: Chris Tomlinson was born in Baltimore and graduated from North Carroll High School in 2004.
He earned a B.S. in electronic media and film from Towson University in 2009.

Tomlinson has been a contracts manager at the Maryland Transit Administration since 2021, after serving as Board of Public Works coordinator and as quality assurance and quality control manager of procurement, according to his legislative biography.
He has also written a biweekly state and local political opinion column for the Carroll County Times and Baltimore Sun.
Tomlinson assumed office on January 11, 2023, according to Ballotpedia.
The General Assembly website lists him as a member of the Government, Labor, and Elections Committee.
